tools.name: match_playlists
tools.description: Returns currently active Spotify playlists that fit a song or description, with follower counts, fit reasons and a results_url for the full list. Input: a Spotify track link or a free-text description of the song, optionally the artist and a genre. Curator names and contacts are not returned.

song.description: Spotify track URL, or a free-text description of the song.

tools.name: check_playlist
tools.description: Returns a 0-100 integrity estimate for a public Spotify playlist with confidence and contributing factors (follower and engagement patterns, curator activity), plus whether PlaylistMap tracks it. Input: a playlist URL or its 22-character id. Screening signal from public data, not proof.

url.description: Spotify playlist URL or 22-character playlist id.
